The TSK plant collects seepage water in a storm water collection unit. This water has high levels of Total Suspended Solids (TSS), Chemical Oxygen Demand (COD), and other organic pollutants, rendering it unsuitable for direct use in the Zero Effluent Discharge (ZED) plant. A pilot plant has been established, consisting of an electrochemical reactor, a clarifier with ultrafiltration, and a polishing unit with adsorbents. The trials have achieved nearly a 90% reduction in COD, turbidity, and TSS, bringing the treated water within acceptable limits for the ZED plant.
